summary: SciSparc Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report) disclosing an October 15, 2026 inducement letter with noteholder L.I.A Pure Capital Ltd. The holder agreed to convert the February 12, 2026 convertible note, with $2,023,039.21 outstanding principal and accrued interest, into ordinary shares at $1.50 per share, implying roughly 1.35 million shares. No cash proceeds accrue to SciSparc and no additional payment is required. Closing is expected on or about October 16, 2026; resale shares are registered on Form F-3. Watch conversion-driven dilution and any resulting selling pressure.
